Bid Summary.value: Austin ISD requires a refresh of student and administrative laptops for high school campuses across the district. The procurement scope includes 1,200 units of Lenovo ThinkPad L15 Gen 5 laptops and 1,200 units of Lenovo USB-C Universal Docks with associated 3-year extended warranties. Objectives are to provide high-performance hardware meeting specific technical and environmental standards. Deliverables consist of the specified laptop units, universal docks, and a warranty certificate or affidavit upon award.
